title: Sentences
intro: Prose has its own units. A sentence ends at `.`, `!` or `?` followed by a space or line end. `)` jumps to the start of the next sentence and `(` back to the start of the current or previous one. As text objects, `is` is the sentence itself and `as` includes the space after it, so `das` deletes a sentence cleanly.
summary: Move and edit by sentence in comments, docs and commit messages.
